maya_docs: Starting draft for relnotes + changelog section for Embed Streaming opt-in. Need: short whats-new bullet, one-line migration, known-issues, and updated SDK snippets (py/ts). Anyone on snippets + link cleanups? :pen:

kevin_sdk: I can do snippets. Quick Q: do we want to show the new context-manager pattern (py) and async-iterator (ts)?

maya_docs: Yes. Keep both minimal. Also add a short note under Known issues about duplicate-final-token when legacy chunking is enabled and that Dedicated customers should set chunk_size=0 or use the helper.

eli_infra: Small infra note: our redirect rules are flaky for /docs/embed -> currently 302 -> external -> 404 in prod. If docs link to /docs/embed in relnotes, marketing copy will break the campaign. We should change internal links to /docs/embeddings and patch redirects in netlify/_redirects.

kevin_sdk: Draft snippets below. Will push PR with full edits shortly.

kevin_sdk: ```python
# python (recommended v0.10+)
with client.embeddings.streaming(model=\"embed-xl\", input=text) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        handle(chunk)

# avoid legacy chunking which can double-flush
# legacy: client.embeddings.stream(...)
```

kevin_sdk: ```ts
// typescript (recommended)
const stream = client.embeddings.streaming({ model: 'embed-xl', input })
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  handle(chunk)
}
```

sam_platform: Note for relnotes: add a short performance caveat — canary saw 5-10% tail latency increase with very large batches when stream=true + large batch_size. Not a blocker, but list under Known issues with mitigation: reduce max_batch_size or use Dedicated pools with burst config.

maya_docs: Good point. Add a 1-line mitigation note. Also include a tiny migration helper command for repo scanning so teams can find legacy calls: `git grep "embeddings.stream(" -- "**/*.{py,js,ts}"` in the migration guide.

kevin_sdk: Added grep example to the migration section in the PR description. Also fixed two Markdown anchors that were causing the snippet-linter to flag the doc (bad anchor `#streaming-embeds` -> should be `#embeddings-streaming`).

release-bot: docs PR 4622 opened by kevin_sdk -> https://stash.example/pulls/4622 (staging). CI: linkcheck, snippet-linter, mdspell. Current status: linkcheck FAILED (1 redirect chain), snippet-linter WARN (code fence language mismatch), mdspell OK.

eli_infra: I'll look at the redirect chain. Likely stale /docs/embed redirect in netlify config. I'll push a patch to the redirects file and re-run linkcheck.

kevin_sdk: Pushed update for code fence languages and fixed the anchor. Pushed at 1776004701. cc @maya_docs for final wording on whats-new bullet.

tina_marketing: For the public blurb, can we keep the whats-new line single-sentence? Eg: \"Embed Streaming (opt-in): lower latency and cost for embeddings with streaming; see migration notes for a quick upgrade.\" I'll wait for final confirm before we schedule the announcement.

maya_docs: Draft whats-new (one line): \"Embed Streaming (opt-in): real-time embeddings via streaming; opt-in required — see migration notes for a quick update and known issues.\" I'll incorporate Tina's wording.

eli_infra: Redirect patch merged to staging at 1776004802. Re-running linkcheck... linkcheck: PASS. snippet-linter: WARN resolved after kevin's push.

release-bot: CI green on staging. Moving relnotes draft to release branch. Tagging relnotes: ready-to-publish. :tada:

maya_docs: Thanks team. Action items: kevin -> merge PR and add migration snippet to migration-guide page; eli -> ensure redirect is in prod; tina -> prep announcement copy; sam -> confirm Dedicated note in customer-facing KB. Will ship once prod redirect is live. :rocket:
